evidence_quotes.quote: Semi-wireless 12-speed Di2: wireless ST-R9270 levers (CR1632), RD-R9250 wireless master hub with built-in ANT+/BLE, hardwired via EW-SD300 to BT-DN300 (52 g, ~1,000 km) and FD-R9250
CS-R9200 12-speed Hyperglide+ cassettes fit both 12-speed-only HG-L2 spline and legacy 11-speed road HG freehub bodies; incompatible with SRAM XDR or Flattop chains
FC-R9200 left crank fixing bolts 12-14 Nm; CS-R9200 cassette lockring 30-50 Nm (target 40 Nm); Shimano Mineral Oil hydraulic system only

adversarial_checks: Freehub directionality checked: Correctly documented that 12s CS-R9200 fits legacy 11s HG hubs, whereas 11s cassettes do NOT fit 12s-only HG-L2 hubs.
Drivetrain & cable trap verified: Distinguished EW-SD300 (12s) from EW-SD50 (11s), confirmed 1x CR1632 per ST-R9270 lever, and verified built-in D-Fly wireless chip in RD-R9250.
Safety & SM-02 check: Highlighted Mineral Oil vs DOT incompatibility and set asin: null under msrp_benchmark_mode.
